spans.s: अजितसेन author of the Cintāmaṇi- prakāśika a gloss on Cintāmaṇi, the well known commentary by Yakṣa- varman on the Sabdānuśāsana of Śākatāyana. Ajitasena was the grand pupil of Abhayadeva; he lived in the 12th century A.D.
आजिरादिगण class of words headed by the word अजिर which do not allow lengthening of the final vowel by
. although they form technical terms e. g. अजिरवती, पुलिन- वती etc. cf. Kāś on
